description: Operator in the Concierge channel asks about a customer's order status by name, with no customer linked to the thread. The agent should call find_customer with by='query' first to resolve the customer.
whyModelNeeded: The model must choose an identity lookup before an order lookup when the operator provides only a name.

messages.contentText: Can you check Jane Doe's order status?
